description: List credit notes (Gutschriften), filterable by status, number, date range and contact. Status: 100 draft, 200 open/delivered, 750 partially paid, 1000 paid. sevdesk: GET /CreditNote.

contact_id.description: Only credit notes for this contact id.

count_all.description: If true, the response also carries `total`, the full match count.

credit_note_number.description: Only the credit note with this number.

embed.description: Comma-separated nested resources to expand inline, e.g. contact,category.

end_date.description: Only credit notes dated on or before this, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip, for paging.

start_date.description: Only credit notes dated on or after this, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

status.description: Only credit notes with this status code.

name: sevdesk_list_credit_notes
title: List credit notes
